title: 9月加息如果是保障型：市场反应有限，关键看定性
speaker: Tai Hui

segments.en: has he limited his options by effectively stopping short but telling the market that the inclination is to hike interest rates and if they do hike interest rate is that actually a better a good thing for markets
segments.zh: 他是否通过暗示加息倾向而限制了自己的选择？如果真加息，对市场是好事吗？

segments.en: so on the first question before Jackson whole market was surprising 30 70 right 30 percent chance of a move 70 percent on hold I think now it feels a little more like a coin toss it's going to be contingent on upcoming CPI and the non-von payrolls
segments.zh: 杰克逊霍尔之前市场预期加息概率30%、按兵不动70%。现在更像抛硬币，取决于即将公布的CPI和非农就业数据。

segments.en: and contributed by his speech market is moving towards 50 50 50 so I think this may be sort of a state that he wants the market to be that to be open minded about any decision
segments.zh: 受他演讲影响，市场正转向50对50。我认为这可能是他希望市场保持开放心态的状态。

segments.en: in so far as the market reactions are concerned if they are a hiking interest rate in September I think the reaction is going to come down to how that move is characterized if this is a characterized as one of risk management the insurance type of a hike I don't think a market will move very much
segments.zh: 就市场反应而言，如果9月加息，关键在于如何定性。如果被定性为风险管理式的保险型加息，市场不会大幅波动。

segments.en: I think this is essentially what the market is currently pricing in but if there's an indication that this is a start of a new hiking cycle there's a series of hikes lying there after then that's not what the market right now has in mind and the market reaction could be a long move violent
segments.zh: 这基本是市场当前定价。但如果暗示这是新一轮加息周期的开始，后续还有一系列加息，那市场反应可能会剧烈。
